title: Reasoning from stated conditions
bodyMd: A review office marks a case complete exactly when it has both the signed form and the supporting statement. Case Rowan has the form but no statement. Case Hazel has both. No decision on the merits follows merely from the complete label.
accessibilityText: Read the accompanying original prose passage. All information needed for the questions is in the passage.
